title: Signal: pnpm override replaces a transitive range with a wildcard
scope: A pnpm-lock.yaml file that declares an override that forces a transitive dependency to accept any version.
limitations: It matches an override that forces a transitive dependency to accept any version in the parsed pnpm-lock.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pnpm-lock.yaml that mentions an override that forces a transitive dependency to accept any version in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
